text: {"rules":[{"jurisdiction":"NJ","level":"state","category":"application_screening_fees","status":"in_force","title":"NJ cap on residential rental application fees ($50, CPI-adjusted)","requirement":"A landlord or agent may not require an application or similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes that exceeds $50. Beginning January 1 of the year next following enactment and each year after, the cap is adjusted in proportion to the percent change in the CPI (NY-Northern NJ-Long Island, All Urban Consumers, All Items) over the 12 months ending October 31 of the prior year. The adjustment is made only if the change is greater than zero. The Director of the Division of Consumer Affairs publishes the applicable limit annually on the division's website and adopts implementing rules, including a mechanism for applicants to report violations.
